Metadata.Goal: Provide two deterministic relational DomainContext bundles that execute the complete representative Operation matrix.
Metadata.Description: Create public immutable IT asset and commerce bundles with exact presets, real handlers, relational seed/probes, composed trees, selection/batch semantics, server startup composition, and matrix verification.

TaskSpace.name: add-domain-context-reference-bundles
TaskSpace.Description: Establish public package/catalog invariants, implement each domain tests-first, then execute the full cross-bundle matrix and server/build boundaries.

TaskGroup.name: Package and catalog authority
TaskGroup.Description: Create the package boundary and validate immutable authoring catalogs before operation implementation.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: both catalog skeletons load with exact complete presets
public import/package guard and package build pass

Task.name: Write package, loader, and catalog RED tests
Task.Description: Add package-boundary tests and catalog fixtures asserting two ids, read-only Kon, semantic resource families, complete matrix definitions/presets/bindings/probes, exact preset/catalog parity, freeze/no execution state, no web-server dependency, and capsule integrity. Do not implement bundles.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Tests require both live-API bundle shapes and every normative matrix definition/resource
Tests parse and catalog-match every complete preset and require deterministic seed/probe coverage
Boundary tests reject web-server, capsule, private/generated/subpath/test imports and undeclared dependencies

Task.name: Implement package skeleton and immutable catalogs
Task.Description: Create depa-data-domain-context-bundles, shared exact request/definition helpers, both Kon/entity catalogs, semantic resources, seeds, placeholder-capable registered handlers/probes, complete presets, capabilities and plain registration exports. All loader/catalog tests must pass without private imports.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Both bundles load/freeze and use only catalog, seed, bindings, probes with no server/current/execution state
All required dimensions, child definitions, preset scenarios, semantic resources and explicit association entities are present
Package build and boundary guard pass using contract/runtime public roots only

TaskGroup.name: IT asset lifecycle bundle
TaskGroup.Description: Implement the IT asset matrix with real relational changes, composed children, business outcomes, and root probes.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: IT asset focused operation matrix passes
CancelRepair rollback/tree and semantic write observations are truthful

Task.name: Write IT asset operation matrix RED tests
Task.Description: Execute presets only through public runtime and cover BO query, CancelRepair success/failure exact child order, standalone MarkCanceled, association link, lifecycle guard transition, constraint valid/violation outcomes, ReturnReinbound composition, and ScrapAndDispose. Assert outcome/effects/probes/diff/tree/diagnostics/rollback. Do not implement handlers.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: All normative IT asset owner/behavior shapes have executable RED cases
CancelRepair tests require four registered child refs in order, multi-entity observations, commit on success and rollback on failure
Constraint business violations are distinguished from thrown execution failures

Task.name: Implement IT asset handlers, probes, and presets
Task.Description: Implement payload validation, public reads/full-row writes, explicit link entity, lifecycle read guard, registered child invocation, structured constraint outcomes, business process child composition and extension action. Parent probes read all affected entities; no hidden state or dimension switch.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: BO query/action/mutations and CancelRepair child registry execute with truthful tree and transaction facts
Association, lifecycle, process and disposal operations change real seeded rows with mutation/probe evidence
Constraint valid/violation outcomes and execution failure/rollback semantics pass focused tests

TaskGroup.name: Commerce operations bundle
TaskGroup.Description: Implement global, selection, batch, capability and raw operation shapes over deterministic order data.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: selection/batch/raw semantics and outcomes are distinct and truthful

Task.name: Write commerce operation matrix RED tests
Task.Description: Cover global computed summary; filter, all, and ids selection mode=single, including unfiltered read and deterministic eligible-row resolution for all; atomic and best-effort CorrectOwner batch keys/status; capability child tree; raw graph/tree/table queries; raw IngestBatch payload batch mode=single; before/after/diff/mutations and failure mapping. Do not implement handlers.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Domain-context, selection, batch, capability and all four raw operation shapes have executable RED cases
Selection filter/all/ids remain one invocation; all uses unfiltered read with deterministic shared-payload mutations/probes; batch items retain independent keys/payload/status
Composite/graph/tree/table outcomes and raw ingest real writes are asserted without fabricated SQL

Task.name: Implement commerce handlers, probes, and presets
Task.Description: Implement equality/public-read selector resolution for filter and ids plus unfiltered read for all, deterministic in-handler eligibility filtering, full-row shared-payload updates, batch validation/failure scenario, global/raw outcomes, capability invokeChild composition, and atomic single-invocation ingest writes with root probes.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Global, selection, batch, capability and raw handlers execute through operation-ref registry only
Filter/all/ids selection and atomic/best-effort batch semantics pass with real state, truthful probes, and item mapping
Raw outcomes and ingest mutations/probes are JSON-safe, truthful, and deterministic

TaskGroup.name: Cross-bundle integration and server composition
TaskGroup.Description: Prove complete matrix coverage, fresh execution, production startup registration, and build/boundary integrity.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: bundle/server/typecheck/root builds, guards and capsule manifests pass

Task.name: Integrate server registrations and verify complete matrix
Task.Description: Add bundle before server in root build, declare server dependency, compose both plain registrations only in import.meta.main, keep createApp default empty, and add server catalog/preset direct-execution integration plus sequential/concurrent matrix coverage. Run bundle, contract, runtime, server tests/builds, boundary guards, strict Codument checks and capsule manifests.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Every preset parses, catalog-matches, loads, serializes through server, and is directly executable unchanged
Representative matrix and sequential/concurrent deterministic isolation pass across both bundles
Production startup registers both ids while createApp default remains empty and dependency direction stays acyclic
Focused/full builds, AST import guards, diff/XML/Codument checks and protected capsule manifests pass
